_note: Single source of truth for every recurring character. episode.py copies `identity`, `wardrobe` and `voice` verbatim into each shot prompt, so the text never drifts between shots. Edit here (and log the change in ledger.json) when the user corrects a character; never retype a character inline in an episode file. Faces are original designs: young, naturally good-looking, each with one or two specific asymmetric details so muse never settles on a famous face. Wardrobe follows the reference film: camel, rust, burnt orange, cream and denim, quilted and cable-knit textures. `letter` is the speaker letter for dub.py (VOICE_<letter> = `tts`); `sex` maps cues to W/M for qa.py/speakers.py. Never use W or M as a letter.

NORA.name: Nora Kessler
NORA.role: Claims typist, just hired at Keystone Mutual Insurance downtown; back home in Larkmont in September 1985 after two years at a Philadelphia secretarial job fell through; lives with her mother and her kid sister Lucy.
NORA.personality: Dry, quick, observant; jokes to hide nerves; proud, hates asking for help.
NORA.flaw: Says yes to everything at work, then panics privately.
NORA.motivation: Prove she came home by choice, not because she failed.
NORA.identity: Nora, a 23-year-old white American woman, naturally beautiful in an unretouched, girl-next-door way: soft oval face, clear light skin with a faint flush on the cheeks, warm hazel-green eyes under soft natural brows, a straight nose with a slightly rounded tip, full lips with a gentle natural pink, a small mole high on her RIGHT cheekbone. Big, voluminous 1985 hair: thick dark-chestnut waves past the shoulders, feathered back from the face, lots of body. Light make-up only: mascara, soft peach blush, a little lip gloss. Slim, 5 ft 6 in.

wardrobe.work: cream chunky cable-knit turtleneck sweater under a knee-length camel wool coat, high-waisted brown wool trousers, low tan leather boots, small gold stud earrings, a tan leather shoulder bag
wardrobe.home: high-waisted light-blue jeans, oversized oatmeal fisherman sweater, white canvas sneakers
wardrobe.coat: knee-length camel wool coat with wide lapels

NORA.voice: warm alto, Mid-Atlantic American English with a light Philadelphia edge on 'water', dry deadpan timing, quick but never rushed
NORA.still: in the passenger seat of a car with orange vinyl upholstery, a sunny suburban street behind the windshield

LUCY.name: Lucy Kessler
LUCY.role: Nora's little sister, fourth grade at Larkmont Elementary; new kid in class after the family's move across town.
LUCY.personality: Earnest, curious, collects facts and repeats them at the worst moment.
LUCY.motivation: Make one real friend in the new school.
LUCY.identity: Lucy, a 9-year-old white American girl: round face, big warm brown eyes, long sandy-blonde hair past the shoulders, held back with a red plastic barrette, a stubborn cowlick at the crown; clearly a little girl, light freckles across the nose, a visible gap where an upper-left front tooth is growing in, small pointed chin. Small for her age.

wardrobe.school: oatmeal-and-brown Fair Isle knit sweater, rust corduroy pants, brown leather boots, a blue nylon backpack
wardrobe.home: pale pink flannel pajamas or a striped long-sleeve t-shirt and jeans

LUCY.voice: bright, clear child's voice, fast thinker but speaks at a normal pace, flat American vowels
LUCY.still: in the toy aisle of a 1985 supermarket, out-of-focus shelves of toy boxes behind

TOMMY.name: Tommy Kessler
TOMMY.role: Nora's brother; dropped out of Penn State after one semester, works the counter at Groove Records on Market Street and plays bass in a garage band; fixes radios at a basement workbench like their late father did.
TOMMY.personality: Charming, lazy about everything except music; protective of Lucy.
TOMMY.motivation: Get the band one real gig before their mother makes him go back to college.
TOMMY.identity: Tommy, a 19-year-old white American man, boyishly handsome: lean face with high cheekbones and a narrow jaw, clear light-blue eyes, light brown slightly arched brows, a small bump on the bridge of his nose, an easy lopsided grin that lifts the LEFT corner of his mouth more. Light-brown hair in a 1985 cut, shaggy and layered, long over the ears and collar. Clean-shaven. Tall and lanky.

wardrobe.everyday: faded denim jacket with a tan sherpa collar over a mustard-and-brown striped t-shirt, high-waisted light jeans, brown suede sneakers
wardrobe.outdoor: rust-orange down puffer vest over a grey hooded sweatshirt, jeans

TOMMY.voice: light easy baritone, laid-back central Pennsylvania English, a little mumbled when he is caught out
TOMMY.still: behind the counter of a small 1985 record store, racks of vinyl albums softly blurred behind

DANNY.name: Danny Ruiz
DANNY.role: Mechanic at Ruiz Service, his uncle Hector's two-bay gas station on Route 11; lives across Orchard Street from the Kesslers; takes night classes for an associate degree.
DANNY.personality: Easy-going, funny, generous with time; quietly ambitious.
DANNY.flaw: Jokes past anything serious; leaves things unfinished.
DANNY.motivation: Earn enough to open his own garage without disappointing his uncle.
DANNY.identity: Danny, a 25-year-old Puerto Rican-American man born in Pennsylvania, handsome in a warm, everyday way: square jaw, warm dark-brown eyes with long lashes, thick dark brows, a wide easy smile, warm light-brown skin. Thick dark-brown wavy hair, full on top and over the ears, 1985 style. Clean-shaven. Broad shoulders, 5 ft 10 in.

wardrobe.off: burnt-orange diamond-quilted nylon jacket over a blue chambray shirt, high-waisted dark jeans, brown leather belt, brown work boots
wardrobe.work: navy mechanic's work shirt with a blank white oval name patch, matching navy work pants, black work boots, a red shop rag in the back pocket

DANNY.voice: warm tenor, quick-witted, relaxed American English with a light Spanish lilt on names; a few words of Spanish only with family
DANNY.still: leaning on the fender of a pale blue 1972 pickup outside a small 1985 gas station, tyre stacks and autumn trees blurred behind

GRACE.name: Grace Whitfield
GRACE.role: Senior claims assistant at Keystone Mutual, two years in; trains Nora; sings in the choir at Bethel AME church and saves for law school.
GRACE.personality: Precise, formal at work, privately very funny; notices everything.
GRACE.flaw: Trusts procedure more than people at first; slow to praise.
GRACE.motivation: Get into law school at Penn State Dickinson next fall.
GRACE.identity: Grace, a 24-year-old Black American woman, strikingly beautiful: heart-shaped face, high rounded cheekbones, smooth deep-brown skin, large warm dark eyes, softly arched brows, a single deep dimple in her LEFT cheek only when she smiles, full lips with a warm berry lipstick. Hair in a soft rounded 1985 shoulder-length curly style, glossy black. Small gold hoop earrings. Medium height, upright posture.

wardrobe.work: rust-red wool blazer with padded shoulders over a cream silk blouse with a soft bow tie, mid-length brown pleated skirt, low brown pumps, thin gold wristwatch
wardrobe.off: camel wool overcoat, burgundy knit scarf

GRACE.voice: measured, rich mezzo, crisp consonants at work, a slower warmer rhythm when she relaxes
GRACE.still: at a steel desk in a sunny 1985 office with tall windows, typewriters blurred behind

ELLIE.name: Ellie Sobczak
ELLIE.role: Waitress at the Ridge Diner on Market Street, her grandmother's place; knows every family in town; was two years below Nora in high school.
ELLIE.personality: Brisk, nosy, kind; feeds people when she cannot fix their problems.
ELLIE.motivation: Keep the diner open against the new highway fast-food places, and get her grandmother to let her run it.
ELLIE.identity: Ellie, a 21-year-old Polish-American woman, bright and pretty: round face, rosy cheeks, light-blue eyes with a soft brown liner, a small upturned nose, a tiny chip on the corner of one front tooth, a wide friendly smile. Big feathered honey-blonde 1985 hair, layered, flipped back from the face and full at the sides. A thin gold chain with a small oval medal at the throat. Short and curvy.

wardrobe.work: white short-sleeved waitress blouse with a peter-pan collar under a burnt-orange apron dress, white sneakers, a pencil behind one ear, an order pad in the apron pocket

ELLIE.voice: brisk, bright alto, fast clipped diner talk, says 'hon' to everyone
ELLIE.still: behind the chrome counter of a 1950s diner, red vinyl stools and a pie case blurred behind
